page_title: JUV 1-1 CAG | Juventus v Cagliari 06/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) sends it out of play.
90+6' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
90+6' Adam Obert (Cagliari) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the left post! A few inches to the right and it could have been a sweet goal!
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
89' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) is awarded a yellow card and sent off by Livio Marinelli because it's his second one today.
88' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
88' 1 - 1 Goal! Razvan Marin (Cagliari) puts the ball into the top left corner past the outstretched arm of Michele Di Gregorio.
87' The Cagliari players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
87' Referee Livio Marinelli makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Cagliari. Let’s see what happens!
87' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Cagliari for a penalty. Play continues.
84' The referee shows the yellow card to Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus).
80' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.

78' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
77' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Samuel Mbangula is replaced by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus).
77' Substitution. Michel Adopo is replaced by Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari).
76' Davide Nicola has decided to substitute Nadir Zortea and he is replaced by Kingstone Mutandwa (Cagliari).
76' Cagliari couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Michele Di Gregorio (Juventus) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
75' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) gets booked.
72' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Simone Scuffet stops the ball from going inside right post.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Danilo (Juventus) comes onto the pitch so that Nicolo Savona can be given a rest.
67' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
65' Substitution. Razvan Marin (Cagliari) on for Antoine Makoumbou.
62' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Weston McKennie (Juventus) replaces Manuel Locatelli.
62' Substitution. Douglas Luiz (Juventus) replaces Khephren Thuram.
59' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
58' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
57' Davide Nicola decides to make a substitution. Nicolas Viola will be replaced by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari).
57' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Tommaso Augello walks off the pitch to be replaced by Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari).
56' The yellow card goes to Nicolo Savona (Juventus).
53' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him.
51' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
50' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
47' A lofted pass into the box is met by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus), who rifles a shot just wide of the right post.
46' Thiago Motta makes a half-time substitution. Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) comes on in place of Teun Koopmeiners.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Livio Marinelli has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
43' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle after Yerry Mina (Cagliari) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
42' Adam Obert (Cagliari) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
40' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
37' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but Michele Di Gregorio comes off his line to gather the ball.
34' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
33' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Khephren Thuram (Juventus) was quite harsh and Livio Marinelli didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
32' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
31' Juventus are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
30' Juventus take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
27' The resulting corner, taken by Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus), comes to nothing.
26' Superb touch by Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) as he receives a precise pass inside the box. He finds the keeper prepared as he unleashes his shot to the left side of the goal. Wonderful save!
25' An attempted cross from Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is cleared.
22' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
20' A snap shot by Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Simone Scuffet produces a good save to thwart him.
19' A wild pass somehow finds Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
19' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
19' Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Juventus.
17' Referee Livio Marinelli sees the trip by Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
15' 1 - 0 Goal! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Simone Scuffet.
15' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is going to take the penalty!
15' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Juventus!

13' Play continues despite the shouts by some Juventus players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Livio Marinelli interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
13' Surely that's handball by one of the Cagliari players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
13' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
11' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block. Juventus have a corner.
11' Simone Scuffet pulls off a great save to deny Nicolo Savona (Juventus), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
9' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
9' Nicolo Savona (Juventus) rises high to connect with a perfect corner kick and heads from the edge of the box towards the right post, but it doesn't have enough accuracy to beat the goalkeeper.
9' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) takes the corner.
8' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
6' The goalkeeper denies the long-range shot from Nicolas Viola (Cagliari). It wasn't such a big threat for him.
5' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
3' Cagliari have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
2' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Juventus will kick the game off.
Livio Marinelli is introduced as the referee for today's match.
